purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for a Matriarch pollination-escrow dispute on Zyphos.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for the Umbros-facing saddle, ordinary escrow work, three relationship-service choices, rival cargo arrival, quarantine, evidence, and three ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the establishing slope, body-specific routine work, each service choice, the rival arrival, the quarantine power shift, the evidence fold, and each ending family. The quarantine ring and the moment aligned route parties force the gestation hollow open receive their own replay frames.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt is a complete standalone frame for a general image model. It describes the saddle geometry, materials, low-energy light, alien bodies, tools, and positions in visible language. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints outside prompt assembly.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: painterly ecological science-fantasy storybook illustration, tactile alien bark and resin, restrained low-energy palette of dusk violet, cold bioluminescent blue, fungal amber and quarantine white, crisp readable silhouettes, precise six-limbed Airawa anatomy, expressive nonhuman posture, cinematic interactive-fiction framing, purely pictorial composition.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each image prompt from the global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for characters actually listed as visible in that scene, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Each assembled prompt restates the visible geometry; continuity never depends on a previous generated image.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture returns to one outdoor saddle from several angles and uses sightlines, climbing routes, a cargo crossing, and branch-persistent light and quarantine states. The included draft map fixes those relationships for B-level replay planning.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency website art, build a plan view or simple 3D blockout with west Matriarch root wall and gestation hollow, central lantern-tree handoff roost, east root bridge, fungal road and fen descent, overhead courier perches, cargo staging cup, and the quarantine-ring boundary.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view of an alien arboreal saddle on Zyphos beneath Umbros, a huge stationary neighboring planet filling part of a dim violet sky as eclipse shadow approaches. On the west uphill side, the receiving Matriarch appears as an immense living wall of layered dark bark and arching roots around a shallow oval gestation hollow sealed by translucent amber living folds. In the center, a smaller lantern tree leans over a broad forked-branch handoff roost, with cold blue bioluminescent knots hanging below its canopy and a stone-resin cargo cup built into the bark. An elevated root bridge reaches the roost from the east. Below it, a braided fungal road climbs from a shallow reflective fen, marked by small amber fruiting beads. Threadwing couriers circle above as small tapered gliding animals with long ribbonlike sensory vanes and gripping feet; one rust-brown courier carries a single crimson sensory ribbon. The composition makes west root wall, central roost, east bridge, lower road, fen, and sky readable at once.

visible_characters.default_stance: circling above the central roost, crimson sensory vane visible

visual_continuity_notes: Local coordinates remain fixed: receiving Matriarch west and uphill; rival approach east; handoff roost center; fungal road and fen below; courier perches overhead.
Umbros remains fixed in the same sector of sky while eclipse shadow advances across the fen from east toward the saddle.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Medium-wide view at the central handoff roost before crisis. Both upper claws and both hooked feet anchor to bark while the lower hands sort translucent sealed cargo sleeves, braided witness cords of shed ribbon fiber, a clean ration of dark grazer dung and pale mineral crumbs, and dead fungal beads on a stone-resin work ledge. A compact rust-brown threadwing with long dark ribbon vanes and one crimson vane waits on an overhead branch while a small clasping parasite grips that red ribbon. Three amber fungal fruiting beads rise below the clerk. Cold blue lantern knots hang beneath the canopy beside a shallow cup holding three pearl-like measures of root sugar. West Matriarch roots and the east bridge frame the background.

waiting on an overhead branch with one parasitized crimson vane lowered

visual_continuity_notes: The clerk's large upper hands are clawed climbing limbs; the smaller lower hands have four soft digits in two opposing pairs; the feet are grasping and taloned.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable fixture-character visual identities for prompt assembly. Include only refs for characters visible in a scene; role handles remain non-Weksa translation scaffolds.

characters.saddle_pollen_clerk: Saddle pollen clerk: mature six-limbed Airawa with moss-gray tiny soft scales, ochre grown plate sections, fine blue-white bioluminescent seams, minimal slit-like nose and ears, two large strong clawed upper arms for climbing and bracing, two smaller lower arms ending in soft four-digit hands arranged as two opposing pairs, long digitigrade legs, four-toed grasping feet and hooked climbing talons. Wears a short violet contract mantle, amber fungal-thread waist bindings, pale lantern-knot filigree, and a low cargo harness that leaves all six limbs free. Work posture uses upper claws and feet as anchors while lower hands handle delicate objects.
characters.rival_archive_nurse: Rival archive nurse: mature six-limbed Airawa with charcoal-teal tiny soft scales, pale bone-colored grown plate sections, fine green bioluminescent seams, minimal slit-like nose and ears, two large clawed upper climbing arms, two smaller four-digit lower manipulator hands, long digitigrade legs and hooked grasping feet. Wears a russet-red contract mantle fastened with pale shed courier-fiber cords and a padded lower-hand cargo sling. Protective posture keeps both lower hands around the gestation sleeve while upper claws and feet maintain escape-ready anchors.
characters.red_vane_courier: Red-vane courier: compact rust-brown threadwing gliding animal with a tapered body, broad flexible flight surfaces edged by many long dark ribbonlike sensory vanes, one unmistakable crimson sensory vane on the left flight edge, small black eyes, narrow mouthparts, and paired gripping feet. Body language uses vane spread, circling, landing distance, fiber shedding, and refusal to land.
characters.cargo_courier: Cargo courier: compact gray-brown threadwing gliding animal with a tapered body, layered flexible flight surfaces edged by long charcoal ribbonlike sensory vanes, small black eyes, narrow mouthparts, and paired gripping feet. Flight posture stays close to the gestation sleeve, with vanes tight around cargo warmth and route residue.
